name: Peninsula Plastics Company, Inc.
old_description: Established in 1980, Peninsula Plastics specializes in manufacturing rugged plastic containers, pallets, and trays.
about:
Peninsula Plastics Company, Inc. was founded in 1980 as a family-owned business in Auburn Hills, Michigan, with a manufacturing plant in Pontiac, Michigan.

The company specializes in thermoformed plastic packaging, producing rugged containers, pallets, and trays through processes that include twin-sheet thermoforming, in-house sheet extrusion, and advanced automation for high-volume runs. Its capabilities span custom design, engineering, program management, prototyping, and pattern making, all managed under one roof to maintain quality control from concept through production.

Peninsula Plastics serves a broad industrial base that includes automotive, food and beverage, system integration, retail, energy, textile, industrial equipment, warehouse and distribution, agricultural, government and military, as well as emerging sectors such as battery and renewable energy, cosmetics and pharmaceuticals, and post and parcel logistics. Customers cited in testimonials range from beverage distributors and industrial manufacturers to automotive OEMs.

The company emphasizes several differentiators: its proprietary TUFF DUNNAGE® line made with recycled content, a buyback program that enables closed-loop recycling, ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certifications, and a hands-on, in-house production approach that the firm says ensures durability, cost-effectiveness, and long-term reuse for demanding supply-chain applications.
